## Review and Rollback

Risks and rollback approach:

- [ ] Changes stay within the selected slice; unrelated work is preserved.
- [ ] Public content contains no secrets, customer records, raw private diagnostics or sensitive reproduction material.
- [ ] Required claims are supported by actual tests; unavailable data is not presented as verified.
- [ ] Applicable exact-head CI and required review are satisfied before merge.
- [ ] Delivery record will link the accepted revision/checks and safe local reconciliation after merge.
- [ ] Production rollout is not implied by this merge; any required approval is separate.
